E. Borrower is the fee simple owner of the Property by virtue of the deed from Hampstead Village Holdings LLC, a South Carolina limited liability company, to Borrower, recorded in the Office of the Register of Mesne Conveyances for Charleston County, South Carolina (the "**RMC Office**") simultaneously with the recording of this Mortgage, and this Mortgage is intended to be junior and subordinate only to the Permitted Exceptions.

F. As a condition to making the Loan, Lender has required that Borrower grant to Lender the liens, security interests, assignments and other rights set forth in this Mortgage, and Borrower has agreed to do so.

**NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the premises, the making of the Loan, and the sum of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, Borrower hereby grants, bargains, sells, aliens, remises, releases, conveys, mortgages, assigns, transfers and sets over to Lender, and grants to Lender a lien upon and security interest in, all of Borrower's estate, right, title, interest, claim and demand, whether now owned or hereafter acquired, in, to and under the following property, rights, interests and privileges (collectively, and together with all Proceeds thereof, the "**Property**"):

## ARTICLE 1 — DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

### 1.1 Defined Terms

For purposes of this Mortgage, the following terms have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Mortgage have the meanings given to them in the Note or, if not defined in the Note, in the other Loan Documents.

"**Annual Debt Service**" means, for any period, the aggregate amount of Debt Service that would be payable during such period on the outstanding principal amount of the Loan, calculated (a) in the case of any period during the Interest-Only Period, on the basis of interest only at the greater of (i) the Interest Rate in effect on the date of determination and (ii) the sum of the SOFR Floor plus the Applicable Spread, and (b) in the case of any period after the Interest-Only Period, on the basis of level monthly payments of principal and interest sufficient to fully amortize the outstanding principal amount of the Loan over a twenty-five (25) year amortization period at the greater of (i) the Interest Rate in effect on the date of determination and (ii) the sum of the SOFR Floor plus the Applicable Spread.

"**Applicable Spread**" means two and eighty-five hundredths percent (2.85%) per annum.

"**Assignment of Leases and Rents**" means the absolute and present assignment of all Leases and Rents contained in Article 3 of this Mortgage.

"**Business Day**" means any day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a day on which commercial banks in Savannah, Georgia or Charleston, South Carolina are authorized or required by law to close.

"**Capital Replacement Reserve**" has the meaning given in Section 6.2.

"**Collateral**" means the Property and all other property, rights and interests in which a security interest is granted to Lender under this Mortgage.

"**Completion Guaranty**" means the Completion Guaranty of even date herewith executed by Guarantor in favor of Lender, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time.

"**Construction Contract**" means that certain construction contract between Borrower, as owner, and the Contractor, as general contractor, providing for a contract sum of Two Million Eight Hundred Fifty Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($2,850,000.00) covering hard costs of construction, together with all schedules, exhibits, change orders and amendments thereto.

"**Contractor**" means Beaufort Builders Group LLC, a South Carolina limited liability company, South Carolina General Contractor License No. SC-GC-47921.

"**Daily SOFR**" means the Secured Overnight Financing Rate as published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or a successor administrator) on the applicable Business Day or, if such rate is not published on such Business Day, the rate published on the immediately preceding Business Day.

"**DSCR**" has the meaning given in Section 13.1.

"**DSCR Test Date**" means the last day of each calendar quarter beginning with the calendar quarter ending June 30, 2027, and thereafter the last day of each successive calendar quarter during the term of the Loan.

"**Default Rate**" means a rate per annum equal to the Interest Rate otherwise applicable plus five percent (5.00%) per annum.

"**Environmental Indemnity**" means the Environmental Indemnity Agreement of even date herewith executed by Borrower and Guarantor in favor of Lender, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time.

"**Environmental Laws**" means all federal, state and local statutes, ordinances, regulations, orders, permits and requirements relating to pollution, the protection of the environment, human health and safety as affected by the environment, or the use, storage, generation, treatment, transportation, disposal or release of Hazardous Materials, including without limitation the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act, 42 U.S.C. § 9601 *et seq.*, and the South Carolina Hazardous Waste Management Act and regulations promulgated thereunder.

"**Escrow Funds**" has the meaning given in Section 6.1.

"**Event of Default**" has the meaning given in Section 16.1.

"**Guaranty**" means the Guaranty Agreement of even date herewith executed by Guarantor in favor of Lender, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time.

"**Hazardous Materials**" means petroleum and petroleum products, perchloroethylene and other volatile organic compounds, asbestos, polychlorinated biphenyls, urea formaldehyde, radon, mold, and any other substance, material or waste regulated as hazardous or toxic under any Environmental Laws.

"**Improvements**" means all buildings, structures, fixtures, building systems and other improvements of every kind now or hereafter located on, in or under the Land, including without limitation the mixed-use building containing approximately 11,400 square feet of ground-floor retail space and approximately 19,600 square feet of upper-floor office space (approximately 31,000 square feet of gross building area in the aggregate), and all HVAC equipment, elevators, plumbing, electrical systems and fire protection systems.

"**Independent Manager**" means a natural person who (a) is not, and has not been within five (5) years prior to his or her appointment, a member, manager, officer, employee, creditor, supplier, customer or contractor of Borrower, any Member, or any Affiliate of any of them, (b) has no direct or indirect economic interest in Borrower, any Member or any of their respective Affiliates, and (c) is not otherwise affiliated with Borrower, any Member or any of their respective Affiliates.

"**Interest-Only Period**" means the period commencing on the Closing Date and ending on April 15, 2027.

"**Interest Rate**" means, for any day, a rate per annum equal to the sum of (a) the greater of (i) Daily SOFR for such day and (ii) the SOFR Floor, plus (b) the Applicable Spread.

"**Land**" means the real property described in Exhibit A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference, being Lots 7, 8 and 9 of the Hampstead Village Plat, as recorded in Plat Book 41 at Page 218, in the RMC Office, together with that certain strip of land formerly known as Anson Lane, vacated by City of Charleston Ordinance No. 2019-084 and conveyed by quitclaim deed recorded in Deed Book 1128 at Page 443, in the RMC Office, and being identified as Charleston County Tax Map Nos. 460-12-04-007, 460-12-04-008 and 460-12-04-009, and commonly known as 520–534 King Street, Charleston, South Carolina 29403.

"**Leases**" means all present and future leases, subleases, subsubleases, licenses, concessions, occupancy agreements and other agreements (whether written or oral) pursuant to which any Person is granted a right to use or occupy all or any portion of the Property, together with all guaranties, letters of credit, security and other credit support for the obligations of the tenants thereunder.

"**Loan Documents**" means, collectively, the Note, this Mortgage, the Assignment of Leases and Rents, the Guaranty, the Completion Guaranty, the Payment Guaranty, the Environmental Indemnity, the UCC-1 financing statements and fixture filings described in Section 2.4, each reserve, escrow or similar agreement between Borrower and Lender, the Operating Agreement Amendment, and each other document, instrument, certificate or agreement now or hereafter executed by Borrower, Guarantor or any other Person in connection with the Loan, as each may be amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time.

"**Lockout Period**" means the period commencing on the Closing Date and ending on April 15, 2027.

## ARTICLE 5 — PAYMENT, INTEREST, MATURITY AND PREPAYMENT

### 5.1 The Note; Principal and Interest

Borrower shall pay the principal of and interest on the Loan, and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, strictly in accordance with the Note and this Mortgage. Interest shall accrue at the Interest Rate and shall be payable monthly in arrears on each Payment Date. During the Interest-Only Period, each monthly installment shall consist solely of accrued interest on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan. Commencing with the payment due on May 15, 2027, and continuing through the Maturity Date, each monthly installment shall be equal to the amount required to fully amortize the then-outstanding principal balance of the Loan over a twenty-five (25) year amortization schedule at the then-applicable Interest Rate.

### 5.2 Interest Rate; SOFR Provisions

(a) The Loan shall bear interest at a floating rate per annum equal to Daily SOFR plus the Applicable Spread, subject to the SOFR Floor. In no event shall the Interest Rate be less than the sum of the SOFR Floor plus the Applicable Spread (being five and eighty-five hundredths percent (5.85%) per annum as of the Closing Date).

(b) Interest shall be computed on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed in each interest period over a three hundred sixty (360) day year. If Daily SOFR is not published or is unavailable for any day, the Interest Rate for such day shall be determined by reference to the rate published for the immediately preceding Business Day.

(c) Lender's determination of Daily SOFR and the Interest Rate for any day shall be made in good faith and shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower absent manifest error. Lender shall provide Borrower with a monthly statement showing the Interest Rate applied and the amount of interest accrued.

(d) If Lender determines in good faith that Daily SOFR has been permanently or indefinitely discontinued or is no longer a widely recognized benchmark, the Interest Rate shall be determined using the rate per annum published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or any successor administrator) as the successor rate recommended for use in place of Daily SOFR, together with any spread adjustment recommended for such successor rate, or, if no such recommendation exists, such alternative rate as Lender and Borrower may agree upon acting in good faith, and in each case giving effect to the SOFR Floor.

### 5.3 Default Rate

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, shall bear interest at the Default Rate, accruing from the date of the Event of Default until such Event of Default is cured or the Loan is repaid in full, whichever first occurs. Interest at the Default Rate shall be payable on demand. Nothing in this Section 5.3 shall limit Lender's right to receive the Default Rate following acceleration or during any period in which any amount remains unpaid after the Maturity Date.

### 5.4 Late Charge

If any monthly installment of principal and/or interest is not received by Lender within ten (10) calendar days after the due date thereof, Borrower shall pay to Lender, on demand, a late charge equal to five percent (5%) of such overdue installment. The late charge is intended to compensate Lender for the additional administrative expense of processing late payments, is not a penalty, and shall be in addition to interest at the Default Rate and all other amounts payable under the Loan Documents.

### 5.5 Payment Mechanics; Application of Payments

All payments shall be made in immediately available funds in lawful money of the United States, without setoff, counterclaim, deduction or withholding, at Lender's address set forth in Section 21.1 or by such other method as Lender may direct. All payments received shall be applied in the following order of priority: (a) late charges and other fees; (b) costs and expenses, including attorneys' fees, incurred by Lender; (c) interest at the Default Rate and interest at the Interest Rate; (d) principal; and (e) any other amounts due under the Loan Documents; provided that Lender may apply payments in any order it elects following the occurrence of an Event of Default. Any payment received after 2:00 p.m. Eastern time on a Business Day shall be deemed received on the next Business Day.

### 5.6 Maturity

The entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, shall be due and payable on the Maturity Date, without notice, presentment or demand, all of which are hereby waived. Borrower acknowledges that the Loan does not fully amortize and that a substantial balloon payment will be due on the Maturity Date.

### 5.7 Prepayment — Lockout Period

Borrower shall have no right to prepay all or any portion of the Loan at any time during the Lockout Period. Any voluntary prepayment attempted or made during the Lockout Period shall be (a) prohibited, and Lender shall be entitled to refuse to accept and to return any such payment, and (b) if accepted by Lender in its sole and absolute discretion, subject to payment of a prepayment premium in the amount that would be payable under Section 5.8 if such prepayment had been made on the last day of the Lockout Period, together with all other amounts then due under the Loan Documents. No partial prepayment of the Loan shall be permitted at any time during the Lockout Period. This Section 5.7 does not apply to (i) the application of casualty insurance proceeds or condemnation awards in accordance with Article 15, or (ii) payments made from Lender's own funds or out of the Reserve Accounts held by Lender, including any application of Reserve Account balances upon acceleration.

### 5.8 Prepayment — Yield Maintenance Period

During the Yield Maintenance Period, Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole (but not in part) at any time, upon not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Lender, which notice shall be irrevocable, provided that Borrower pays to Lender, simultaneously with such prepayment, (a) the entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, (b) all accrued and unpaid interest through the date of prepayment, (c) all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, and (d) the Yield Maintenance Premium. The "**Yield Maintenance Premium**" shall be the greater of:

(i) one percent (1.00%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan as of the date of prepayment; and

(ii) the present value of the excess, if any, of (A) the interest that would have accrued on the amount prepaid at the Note Rate during the period from the date of prepayment through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, over (B) the interest that would have accrued on such amount during such period at a rate per annum equal to the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points, discounted to present value at the Treasury Rate as of the date of prepayment.

In no event shall the Yield Maintenance Premium be less than the amount determined under clause (i) above. No partial prepayment of the Loan shall be permitted during the Yield Maintenance Period.

### 5.9 Computation of Yield Maintenance Premium

The Yield Maintenance Premium shall be determined in accordance with the following methodology, which the parties intend to be mathematically determinative and objectively calculable as of the prepayment date:

(a) The amount prepaid shall be allocated to the scheduled monthly payment periods remaining from the prepayment date through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period (the last such period ending on April 15, 2029). The number of full and partial monthly periods remaining shall be determined by counting, on an actual-day basis, the period from the prepayment date to April 15, 2029.

(b) "**Treasury Rate**" means the yield to maturity, determined as of the second (2nd) Business Day preceding the prepayment date, of the United States Treasury security having a maturity date closest to, but not exceeding, the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, as reported in Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.15 — Selected Interest Rates (or any successor publication) under the caption "Treasury Constant Maturities." If no published maturity date exactly matches the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, the Treasury Rate shall be determined by linear interpolation between the yields reported for the two published maturities nearest to such date, applied on an actual-day basis. If the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period precedes the shortest published maturity, the shortest published maturity shall be used.

(c) The interest differential for each remaining monthly period shall equal the product of (i) the amount prepaid, (ii) the difference (expressed as a per annum rate, and not less than zero) between the Note Rate and the sum of the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points, and (iii) a fraction, the numerator of which is the number of days in such monthly period and the denominator of which is three hundred sixty (360).

(d) The present value of each such interest differential shall be computed by discounting such amount from the last day of the applicable monthly period to the prepayment date using a discount rate equal to the Treasury Rate, applied on an actual/360 basis with monthly compounding.

(e) If Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.15 ceases to be published, the Treasury Rate shall be determined by reference to the successor publication or source designated by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System or, absent such designation, by reference to the yield on the applicable United States Treasury security as reported by a nationally recognized financial information service selected by Lender in good faith.

(f) Lender shall deliver to Borrower, within five (5) Business Days after receipt of Borrower's prepayment notice, a statement setting forth in reasonable detail Lender's computation of the Yield Maintenance Premium. Absent manifest error, Lender's computation shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower.

### 5.10 Prepayment — Open Prepayment Period

During the final twelve (12) months of the term of the Loan (being the period from and including April 16, 2029 through and including the Maturity Date), Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole or in part, at any time and from time to time, without payment of any prepayment premium, penalty, yield maintenance amount or other charge, upon not less than fifteen (15) days' prior written notice to Lender. Any partial prepayment made during such period shall be applied to the scheduled installments of principal in inverse order of maturity.

### 5.11 No Defeasance; No Substitute Collateral

Borrower shall not have the right to defease the Loan, to substitute collateral for the Property or any portion thereof, or to obtain a release of any portion of the Property from the lien of this Mortgage prior to the payment in full of the Obligations, except as expressly provided in Article 15 with respect to casualty and condemnation, or with Lender's prior written consent, which Lender may withhold in its sole discretion.

### 5.12 Involuntary Payments

### 5.13 Usury Savings

### 4.1 Warranty of Title

Borrower represents, warrants and covenants that (a) Borrower is and will remain the sole fee simple owner of the Property, free and clear of all liens, encumbrances, easements, restrictions, adverse claims, options, rights of first refusal, tenancies and other matters affecting title, other than the Permitted Exceptions and the Leases approved by Lender, (b) Borrower has good and marketable title to the Property and good right and lawful authority to mortgage the Property, (c) this Mortgage creates a valid first-priority lien on and security interest in the Property, subject only to the Permitted Exceptions, and (d) there are no mechanic's, materialmen's, judgment, tax or other liens against the Property other than the Permitted Exceptions.

### 4.2 Permitted Exceptions

The lien of this Mortgage is subject and subordinate only to the Permitted Exceptions. Lender's approval of the Permitted Exceptions as of the Closing Date shall not constitute a waiver of, or consent to, any future violation of any covenant, condition or restriction contained in any Permitted Exception, nor a waiver of Borrower's obligations under Section 9.3 with respect thereto. Without limiting the foregoing, Borrower acknowledges that the LUR is a Permitted Exception that runs with the land and that Borrower's compliance with the LUR is an express obligation under Article 12.

### 4.3 Defense of Title; Further Assurances

Borrower shall (a) appear in and defend any action or proceeding purporting to affect the Property, the lien of this Mortgage or Lender's interest therein, at Borrower's sole cost and expense, (b) promptly notify Lender of any such action or proceeding, and (c) execute, acknowledge, deliver, file and record such further instruments and take such further actions as Lender may reasonably request to create, perfect, maintain, protect or enforce the lien of this Mortgage, the security interests granted herein or the Assignment of Leases and Rents, including without limitation the Operating Agreement Amendment, landlord waivers, consents to assignment, subordination agreements, UCC continuation statements, title affidavits and date-down endorsements.

### 4.4 Consent to Encroachments, Easements and Rights-of-Way

Lender consents to the existing encroachments, easements, rights-of-way, party walls and similar matters that constitute Permitted Exceptions, including without limitation (a) the decorative iron balcony extending approximately two and one-half (2.5) feet beyond the front façade of the building over and across the King Street public right-of-way, and (b) the underground utility easement in favor of South Carolina Electric & Gas recorded in Deed Book 987 at Page 112, in the RMC Office. Borrower shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain and maintain any encroachment license, permit or similar approval from the City of Charleston required for the balcony encroachment, and shall deliver copies thereof to Lender. If any governmental authority requires the removal, modification or alteration of the balcony, Borrower shall promptly notify Lender and shall complete such work in accordance with Section 9.2, and the cost thereof shall be borne by Borrower and, to the extent required, by Guarantor under the Completion Guaranty.

### 4.5 The Anson Lane Parcel

Borrower acknowledges that the strip of land formerly known as Anson Lane was conveyed to Borrower's predecessor in title by quitclaim deed recorded in Deed Book 1128 at Page 443, in the RMC Office, and that such conveyance carries no warranty of title. Borrower represents and warrants that, at the Closing Date, title to the Anson Lane strip is vested in Borrower in fee simple and is insured under the Title Policy without any exception that (a) excludes such strip from the insured estate, (b) describes such strip as less than a fee simple estate, or (c) qualifies the Company's willingness to insure such strip other than as disclosed in Exhibit B. Borrower shall cooperate with Lender and the title insurer to obtain such endorsements, affirmative coverage or additional premium arrangements as Lender may reasonably require with respect to the Anson Lane strip, including without limitation coverage under ALTA Endorsement 34 (Identified Exception) or equivalent, and the cost thereof shall be borne by Borrower pursuant to Section 22.9.

### 4.6 No Merger of Estates

If Lender acquires title to the Property or any portion thereof by foreclosure, deed in lieu of foreclosure or otherwise, the lien of this Mortgage and the obligations secured hereby shall not merge into such title, and Lender may thereafter exercise the rights of a mortgagee with respect to any portion of the Property not acquired, all to the extent permitted by applicable law.

## ARTICLE 5 — PAYMENT, INTEREST, MATURITY AND PREPAYMENT

### 5.1 The Note; Principal and Interest

Borrower shall pay the principal of and interest on the Loan, and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, strictly in accordance with the Note and this Mortgage. Interest shall accrue at the Interest Rate and shall be payable monthly in arrears on each Payment Date. During the Interest-Only Period, each monthly installment shall consist solely of accrued interest on the outstanding principal balance of the Loan. Commencing with the payment due on May 15, 2027, and continuing through the Maturity Date, each monthly installment shall be equal to the amount required to fully amortize the then-outstanding principal balance of the Loan over a twenty-five (25) year amortization schedule at the then-applicable Interest Rate.

### 5.2 Interest Rate; SOFR Provisions

(a) The Loan shall bear interest at a floating rate per annum equal to Daily SOFR plus the Applicable Spread, subject to the SOFR Floor. In no event shall the Interest Rate be less than the sum of the SOFR Floor plus the Applicable Spread (being five and eighty-five hundredths percent (5.85%) per annum as of the Closing Date).

(b) Interest shall be computed on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed in each interest period over a three hundred sixty (360) day year. If Daily SOFR is not published or is unavailable for any day, the Interest Rate for such day shall be determined by reference to the rate published for the immediately preceding Business Day.

(c) Lender's determination of Daily SOFR and the Interest Rate for any day shall be made in good faith and shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower absent manifest error. Lender shall provide Borrower with a monthly statement showing the Interest Rate applied and the amount of interest accrued.

(d) If Lender determines in good faith that Daily SOFR has been permanently or indefinitely discontinued or is no longer a widely recognized benchmark, the Interest Rate shall be determined using the rate per annum published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (or any successor administrator) as the successor rate recommended for use in place of Daily SOFR, together with any spread adjustment recommended for such successor rate, or, if no such recommendation exists, such alternative rate as Lender and Borrower may agree upon acting in good faith, and in each case giving effect to the SOFR Floor.

### 5.3 Default Rate

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, shall bear interest at the Default Rate, accruing from the date of the Event of Default until such Event of Default is cured or the Loan is repaid in full, whichever first occurs. Interest at the Default Rate shall be payable on demand. Nothing in this Section 5.3 shall limit Lender's right to receive the Default Rate following acceleration or during any period in which any amount remains unpaid after the Maturity Date.

### 5.4 Late Charge

If any monthly installment of principal and/or interest is not received by Lender within ten (10) calendar days after the due date thereof, Borrower shall pay to Lender, on demand, a late charge equal to five percent (5%) of such overdue installment. The late charge is intended to compensate Lender for the additional administrative expense of processing late payments, is not a penalty, and shall be in addition to interest at the Default Rate and all other amounts payable under the Loan Documents.

### 5.5 Payment Mechanics; Application of Payments

All payments shall be made in immediately available funds in lawful money of the United States, without setoff, counterclaim, deduction or withholding, at Lender's address set forth in Section 21.1 or by such other method as Lender may direct. All payments received shall be applied in the following order of priority: (a) late charges and other fees; (b) costs and expenses, including attorneys' fees, incurred by Lender; (c) interest at the Default Rate and interest at the Interest Rate; (d) principal; and (e) any other amounts due under the Loan Documents; provided that Lender may apply payments in any order it elects following the occurrence of an Event of Default. Any payment received after 2:00 p.m. Eastern time on a Business Day shall be deemed received on the next Business Day.

### 5.6 Maturity

The entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, shall be due and payable on the Maturity Date, without notice, presentment or demand, all of which are hereby waived. Borrower acknowledges that the Loan does not fully amortize and that a substantial balloon payment will be due on the Maturity Date.

### 5.7 Prepayment — Lockout Period

Borrower shall have no right to prepay all or any portion of the Loan at any time during the Lockout Period. Any voluntary prepayment attempted or made during the Lockout Period shall be (a) prohibited, and Lender shall be entitled to refuse to accept and to return any such payment, and (b) if accepted by Lender in its sole and absolute discretion, subject to payment of a prepayment premium in the amount that would be payable under Section 5.8 if such prepayment had been made on the last day of the Lockout Period, together with all other amounts then due under the Loan Documents. No partial prepayment of the Loan shall be permitted at any time during the Lockout Period. This Section 5.7 does not apply to (i) the application of casualty insurance proceeds or condemnation awards in accordance with Article 15, or (ii) payments made from Lender's own funds or out of the Reserve Accounts held by Lender, including any application of Reserve Account balances upon acceleration.

### 5.8 Prepayment — Yield Maintenance Period

During the Yield Maintenance Period, Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole (but not in part) at any time, upon not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Lender, which notice shall be irrevocable, provided that Borrower pays to Lender, simultaneously with such prepayment, (a) the entire outstanding principal balance of the Loan, (b) all accrued and unpaid interest through the date of prepayment, (c) all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, and (d) the Yield Maintenance Premium. The "**Yield Maintenance Premium**" shall be the greater of:

(i) one percent (1.00%) of the outstanding principal balance of the Loan as of the date of prepayment; and

(ii) the present value of the excess, if any, of (A) the interest that would have accrued on the amount prepaid at the Note Rate during the period from the date of prepayment through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, over (B) the interest that would have accrued on such amount during such period at a rate per annum equal to the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points, discounted to present value at the Treasury Rate as of the date of prepayment.

In no event shall the Yield Maintenance Premium be less than the amount determined under clause (i) above. No partial prepayment of the Loan shall be permitted during the Yield Maintenance Period.

### 5.9 Computation of Yield Maintenance Premium

The Yield Maintenance Premium shall be determined in accordance with the following methodology, which the parties intend to be mathematically determinative and objectively calculable as of the prepayment date:

(a) The amount prepaid shall be allocated to the scheduled monthly payment periods remaining from the prepayment date through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period (the last such period ending on April 15, 2029). The number of full and partial monthly periods remaining shall be determined by counting, on an actual-day basis, the period from the prepayment date to April 15, 2029.

(b) "**Treasury Rate**" means the yield to maturity, determined as of the second (2nd) Business Day preceding the prepayment date, of the United States Treasury security having a maturity date closest to, but not exceeding, the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, as reported in Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.15 — Selected Interest Rates (or any successor publication) under the caption "Treasury Constant Maturities." If no published maturity date exactly matches the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, the Treasury Rate shall be determined by linear interpolation between the yields reported for the two published maturities nearest to such date, applied on an actual-day basis. If the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period precedes the shortest published maturity, the shortest published maturity shall be used.

(c) The interest differential for each remaining monthly period shall equal the product of (i) the amount prepaid, (ii) the difference (expressed as a per annum rate, and not less than zero) between the Note Rate and the sum of the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points, and (iii) a fraction, the numerator of which is the number of days in such monthly period and the denominator of which is three hundred sixty (360).

(d) The present value of each such interest differential shall be computed by discounting such amount from the last day of the applicable monthly period to the prepayment date using a discount rate equal to the Treasury Rate, applied on an actual/360 basis with monthly compounding.

(e) If Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.15 ceases to be published, the Treasury Rate shall be determined by reference to the successor publication or source designated by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System or, absent such designation, by reference to the yield on the applicable United States Treasury security as reported by a nationally recognized financial information service selected by Lender in good faith.

(f) Lender shall deliver to Borrower, within five (5) Business Days after receipt of Borrower's prepayment notice, a statement setting forth in reasonable detail Lender's computation of the Yield Maintenance Premium. Absent manifest error, Lender's computation shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower.

### 5.10 Prepayment — Open Prepayment Period

During the final twelve (12) months of the term of the Loan (being the period from and including April 16, 2029 through and including the Maturity Date), Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole or in part, at any time and from time to time, without payment of any prepayment premium, penalty, yield maintenance amount or other charge, upon not less than fifteen (15) days' prior written notice to Lender. Any partial prepayment made during such period shall be applied to the scheduled installments of principal in inverse order of maturity.

### 5.11 No Defeasance; No Substitute Collateral

Borrower shall not have the right to defease the Loan, to substitute collateral for the Property or any portion thereof, or to obtain a release of any portion of the Property from the lien of this Mortgage prior to the payment in full of the Obligations, except as expressly provided in Article 15 with respect to casualty and condemnation, or with Lender's prior written consent, which Lender may withhold in its sole discretion.

### 5.12 Involuntary Payments

Any payment of the Loan made with proceeds of casualty insurance, condemnation awards or other involuntary prepayment shall be applied in accordance with Article 15 and shall not be subject to the Yield Maintenance Premium.

### 5.13 Usury Savings

Notwithstanding any other provision of the Loan Documents, in no event shall the aggregate of all interest and other charges constituting interest under applicable law exceed the maximum rate permitted by applicable law. If any amount in excess of such maximum rate is inadvertently charged or collected, such excess shall be applied to reduce the principal balance of the Loan (or, if the Loan has been paid in full, refunded to Borrower), and the effective rate of interest shall be automatically reduced to the maximum lawful rate. To the extent permitted by applicable law, all amounts constituting interest shall be amortized, prorated, allocated and spread over the full term of the Loan.

## ARTICLE 6 — RESERVES AND ESCROWS

### 6.1 Tax and Insurance Escrow

(a) Borrower shall deposit with Lender, on the Closing Date and on each Payment Date thereafter, an amount equal to one-twelfth (1/12) of the annual amounts, as estimated by Lender in its reasonable discretion, required to pay (i) all real property taxes, assessments, water and sewer charges and other governmental impositions affecting all three (3) tax parcels comprising the Land (Tax Map Nos. 460-12-04-007, 460-12-04-008 and 460-12-04-009), and (ii) all premiums for the property, flood, liability and other insurance required under Article 11, together with any deductibles reasonably anticipated by Lender.

(b) Amounts so deposited (the "**Escrow Funds**") shall be held by Lender in a non-interest-bearing account or, at Lender's election, in an interest-bearing account for the benefit of Borrower (the "**Tax and Insurance Escrow Account**"), and shall be applied by Lender toward the payment of such taxes and insurance premiums as they become due and payable, subject to the provisions of this Article 6 and applicable law. Lender may, in its reasonable discretion, adjust the monthly escrow deposits from time to time based upon actual or anticipated tax assessments, insurance premiums, special assessments or shortages in the Tax and Insurance Escrow Account, and Borrower shall pay any resulting deficiency within thirty (30) days after written demand.

(c) Borrower shall furnish to Lender all tax bills and insurance premium invoices promptly upon receipt and in any event not less than fifteen (15) days prior to the applicable due date. If Borrower fails to furnish any such bill or invoice and Lender pays the same, such payment shall constitute an advance under Section 9.14.

### 6.2 Capital Replacement Reserve

Borrower shall deposit with Lender, on each Payment Date, the sum of Six Hundred Forty-Five and 83/100 Dollars ($645.83) into a capital replacement reserve account held by Lender (the "**Capital Replacement Reserve Account**"), being the amount derived from $0.25 per square foot per year multiplied by 31,000 square feet of gross building area ($7,750.00 per year), divided by twelve (12) months. Funds in the Capital Replacement Reserve Account shall be disbursed to Borrower upon Lender's approval of qualifying capital expenditures for the Property, subject to Lender's reasonable review and approval procedures and the submission of invoices, lien waivers and such other documentation as Lender may reasonably require. Lender may reassess the amount of the monthly deposit no more than once in any twelve (12) month period based upon a property condition assessment or capital needs analysis obtained by Lender.

### 6.3 Tenant Improvement and Leasing Commission Reserve

(a) On the Closing Date, Borrower shall deposit the sum of One Hundred Fifty Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($150,000.00) into a tenant improvement and leasing commission reserve account held by Lender (the "**Tenant Improvement and Leasing Commission Reserve Account**").

(b) Disbursements from the Tenant Improvement and Leasing Commission Reserve Account shall be subject to Lender's prior written approval and shall be used exclusively for tenant improvement costs and leasing commissions incurred in connection with the leasing of vacant space at the Property, including Bay 2 and 2nd Floor Suite B.

(c) Upon any draw-down from the Tenant Improvement and Leasing Commission Reserve Account, Borrower shall, within thirty (30) days after Lender's written demand, replenish the account to the full amount of $150,000.00 from Borrower's own funds. Borrower's failure to replenish within such period shall constitute an Event of Default under Section 16.1(h).

(d) Borrower acknowledges that the Tenant Improvement and Leasing Commission Reserve Account is separate from, and in addition to, the tenant improvement allowances included in the Renovation Budget (Line Item 4.0 thereof). Borrower shall fund tenant improvement costs first from the Tenant Improvement and Leasing Commission Reserve Account and thereafter from the Renovation Holdback, and shall not seek reimbursement for the same cost from both sources.

### 6.4 Renovation Holdback Account

The Renovation Holdback shall be held by Lender in an account maintained by Lender (the "**Renovation Holdback Account**") and shall be disbursed to Borrower solely in accordance with Article 7. Amounts in the Renovation Holdback Account shall not be disbursed to Borrower except upon satisfaction of each applicable condition set forth in Article 7 and Section 20.2.

### 6.5 Reserve Accounts as Collateral; Control

(a) Each Reserve Account is part of the Collateral, and Borrower hereby grants to Lender a security interest in each Reserve Account and all sums held therein. Lender shall have sole dominion and control over each Reserve Account, and Borrower shall have no right to withdraw, direct the investment of or otherwise deal with any Reserve Account except as expressly provided in this Article 6.

(b) Lender may, at its election, apply all or any part of the amounts in any Reserve Account to cure any default of Borrower under the Loan Documents, to pay any tax, insurance premium, capital expenditure, tenant improvement cost or other item for which the applicable Reserve Account was established, or to the payment of the Obligations upon acceleration. Any such application shall not cure any Event of Default other than as expressly provided in Section 16.2.

(c) Borrower acknowledges that each Reserve Account is a deposit account maintained by Lender as secured party, that Lender's security interest therein is perfected by control within the meaning of Section 9-104 of the UCC, and that Borrower has no right to require Lender to maintain any Reserve Account at any particular institution or to deliver any account control agreement.

(d) Upon the payment in full of the Obligations, Lender shall, within a reasonable time, return to Borrower any unapplied amounts remaining in the Reserve Accounts, subject to the terms of the Loan Documents and applicable law.

### 6.6 Waiver; No Interest

Lender shall not be obligated to pay interest on any amounts held in any Reserve Account unless Lender elects to maintain an interest-bearing account, and in that event interest shall be credited in accordance with Lender's customary practices. Borrower waives any claim against Lender for any loss or diminution of principal resulting from the failure of any depository institution at which funds are held.

## ARTICLE 7 — RENOVATION AND CONSTRUCTION

### 7.1 Renovation Budget; Construction Contract

(a) Borrower shall cause the renovation of the Property to be performed substantially in accordance with the Renovation Budget and the plans and specifications approved by Lender, and in compliance with the Construction Contract and all applicable laws, codes and permit requirements.

(b) The Renovation Budget totals $3,150,000.00, comprising HVAC replacement ($1,200,000.00), elevator modernization ($475,000.00), façade restoration ($625,000.00), tenant improvement allowances ($550,000.00) and soft costs and contingency ($300,000.00). The Construction Contract provides for a contract sum of $2,850,000.00 covering hard costs, and the remaining $300,000.00 of soft costs and contingency is outside the scope of the Construction Contract.

(c) The Renovation Holdback of $2,250,000.00 is $600,000.00 less than the Construction Contract sum, and Borrower shall fund all renovation costs in excess of the Renovation Holdback, being approximately $900,000.00, from Borrower's own funds, in accordance with the draw schedule attached as Exhibit C.

(d) Borrower has delivered to Lender a complete copy of the executed Construction Contract, together with all schedules, exhibits and amendments thereto. Borrower shall not amend, supplement, terminate or grant any material waiver or release under the Construction Contract without Lender's prior written consent, except for change orders permitted under Section 7.6.

### 7.2 Draw Requests; Conditions to Disbursement

Borrower may request disbursements from the Renovation Holdback no more frequently than once per calendar month. Each draw request shall be submitted to Lender not less than ten (10) Business Days prior to the requested disbursement date and shall be accompanied by:

(a) an AIA G702/G703 Application and Certificate for Payment, certified by Borrower's architect of record, detailing the work completed, amounts previously paid and the amount then requested;

(b) conditional lien waivers for the current draw, and unconditional lien waivers for all prior draws, from the Contractor and from each subcontractor performing work in an amount exceeding Twenty-Five Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($25,000.00);

(c) a title date-down endorsement from the title insurer confirming that no intervening mechanic's or materialmen's liens or other encumbrances have been filed against the Property since the date of recording of this Mortgage or the most recent date-down endorsement;

(d) evidence of Lender's satisfactory inspection of the work in progress, which inspection may be conducted by a third-party inspector retained by Lender at Borrower's expense pursuant to Section 7.7;

(e) evidence that Borrower has funded, or is then funding concurrently, Borrower's proportionate share of the costs covered by such draw request in accordance with the draw schedule attached as Exhibit C, unless Lender agrees in writing to a different allocation;

(f) with respect to any draw request that includes tenant improvement allowances, evidence of the applicable executed lease, Lender's approval thereof as required by Section 9.6, and the applicable tenant improvement allowance provisions; and

(g) with respect to any work involving or affecting the floor slab of Bay 1 on Lot 7 (Tax Map No. 460-12-04-007), evidence of Borrower's compliance with Section 7.9 and Article 12.

### 7.3 Retainage

Lender shall retain ten percent (10%) of each disbursement from the Renovation Holdback as retainage until Substantial Completion has been achieved. Retainage shall be released upon Lender's receipt of (a) satisfactory evidence of Substantial Completion, including the architect's certificate and the certificate of occupancy, (b) final unconditional lien waivers from the Contractor and all subcontractors, (c) a final title date-down endorsement, and (d) such other evidence as Lender may reasonably require. Borrower acknowledges that the Renovation Holdback of $2,250,000.00, less ten percent (10%) retainage of $225,000.00, will not permit aggregate disbursements exceeding $2,025,000.00 prior to Substantial Completion, and that Borrower is obligated to fund the resulting cash-flow timing difference from Borrower's own funds.

### 7.4 Substantial Completion; Substantial Completion Deadline

Borrower shall achieve Substantial Completion of the renovation on or before the Substantial Completion Deadline (June 15, 2026). Borrower shall deliver to Lender written notice of Substantial Completion within five (5) Business Days after the same is achieved, together with the architect's certificate, the certificate of occupancy and a final AIA G702/G703 application. Borrower's failure to achieve Substantial Completion on or before the Substantial Completion Deadline, subject to the cure period set forth in Section 16.2(c), shall constitute an Event of Default under Section 16.1(j).

### 7.5 Cost Overruns

Borrower shall pay all costs of the renovation in excess of the Renovation Holdback from Borrower's own funds as and when due, and shall not permit any mechanic's, materialmen's or other lien to attach to the Property. If at any time Lender determines in good faith that the then-unfunded portion of the Renovation Holdback is insufficient to complete the renovation in accordance with the Renovation Budget and the approved plans, Borrower shall, within ten (10) Business Days after written demand, deposit with Lender additional funds in the amount of such deficiency, to be held and disbursed as part of the Renovation Holdback. Borrower's failure to make such deposit shall constitute an Event of Default.

### 7.6 Change Orders

Borrower shall not approve or permit (a) any change order, amendment or modification to the Construction Contract, (b) any change in the plans and specifications, or (c) any increase in the Renovation Budget, in any such case that individually or in the aggregate exceeds One Hundred Thousand and No/100 Dollars ($100,000.00), or that reduces the scope of the work in any material respect, without Lender's prior written consent. Borrower may approve change orders not exceeding such threshold in the aggregate, provided that (i) such change orders do not reduce the scope of the renovation in any material respect, (ii) no Event of Default exists, and (iii) Borrower delivers copies of all such change orders to Lender within ten (10) Business Days. In no event shall any change order be funded from the Renovation Holdback unless it increases the Renovation Budget and Lender has approved the funding source.

### 7.7 Inspection

Lender and its agents, representatives, architects, engineers and third-party inspectors may enter upon the Property at reasonable times and upon reasonable prior notice (or at any time without notice following an Event of Default) to inspect the progress and quality of the renovation, the workmanship and materials, and Borrower's compliance with this Article 7. Borrower shall cooperate with all such inspections and shall cause the Contractor to do so. The cost of any such inspection shall be borne by Borrower as provided in Section 22.9.

### 7.8 Failure to Complete; Lender's Right to Complete

If Borrower fails to commence or diligently pursue the renovation, or fails to complete the renovation by the Substantial Completion Deadline, or if an Event of Default occurs and is continuing, Lender may (but shall have no obligation to), in addition to all other remedies available under the Loan Documents, (a) withhold further disbursements from the Renovation Holdback, (b) enter upon the Property and take such actions as Lender deems necessary to complete or protect the renovation, (c) engage the Contractor or another contractor to complete the work, and (d) apply all remaining amounts in the Renovation Holdback Account and any other Reserve Account to the costs thereof. All amounts so expended by Lender shall constitute advances under Section 9.14 and shall be secured by this Mortgage. Lender's exercise of any right under this Section 7.8 shall not cure any Event of Default, shall not constitute an assumption of any obligation of Borrower and shall not create any liability of Lender to Borrower, Guarantor, the Contractor or any other Person.

### 7.9 Bay 1 Slab and Land Use Restriction Coordination

Borrower shall not permit any renovation, construction, demolition or alteration activity that penetrates, removes, compromises or otherwise affects the vapor barrier installed beneath the concrete floor slab of Bay 1 (Lot 7, ground floor) unless (a) Borrower has given prior written notice to SCDHEC as required by the LUR, (b) Borrower has obtained Lender's prior written consent, which consent may be conditioned upon delivery of an environmental consultant's written plan for inspection, repair or replacement of the vapor barrier, and (c) the work is performed in a manner that preserves or restores the integrity of the vapor barrier in compliance with the LUR. Borrower shall deliver to Lender copies of all correspondence with SCDHEC relating to the LUR and all vapor barrier inspection reports within five (5) Business Days after the same are sent or received. Borrower acknowledges that the façade restoration, HVAC replacement and elevator modernization comprising the Renovation Budget may require work in proximity to the Bay 1 slab and agrees to conduct such work in accordance with this Section 7.9.

### 7.10 Permits and Board of Architectural Review Approval

Borrower shall obtain and maintain all permits, licenses and approvals necessary for the renovation, including without limitation approval of the façade restoration (including the decorative iron balcony) by the City of Charleston Board of Architectural Review, in each case prior to the commencement of the affected work. Borrower shall promptly deliver copies of all such permits and approvals to Lender and shall comply with all conditions thereof.

## ARTICLE 8 — REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

Borrower represents and warrants to Lender, as of the Closing Date and as of each date on which any advance is made under the Loan Documents, as follows:

### 8.1 Organization; Authority

Borrower is a limited liability company duly organized, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of South Carolina, is duly qualified to do business in each jurisdiction in which the nature of its business or the ownership of the Property requires such qualification, and has all requisite power and authority to own the Property, to carry on its business as presently conducted and as contemplated by the Loan Documents, and to execute, deliver and perform its obligations under the Loan Documents.

### 8.2 Enforceability; No Conflicts

The execution, delivery and performance by Borrower of the Loan Documents have been duly authorized by all necessary limited liability company action, including by Graydon Development Group LLC as Managing Member and by the Members to the extent required by the Operating Agreement, and do not and will not (a) violate the articles of organization, the Operating Agreement or any other organizational document of Borrower, (b) violate any applicable law, order, judgment or decree, (c) result in a breach of or default under any indenture, agreement or instrument to which Borrower is a party, including without limitation the Leases and the Construction Contract, or (d) require any consent or approval of any Person that has not been obtained. The Loan Documents constitute the legal, valid and binding obligations of Borrower, enforceable against Borrower in accordance with their terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium and similar laws affecting creditors' rights generally and to general principles of equity.

### 8.3 Title; Permitted Exceptions

Borrower has good, marketable and insurable fee simple title to the Property, subject only to the Permitted Exceptions, and this Mortgage constitutes a valid first-priority lien on and security interest in the Property, subject only to the Permitted Exceptions.
